headline: KCR @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 4.59 at MIN 4.63, with a projected total of 9.22. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward KCR: KCR moved +1.03 runs while MIN moved +0.07, changing the projected margin by +0.95 runs. The projected total climbed +1.10, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Andrew Morris has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Maikel Garcia, Vinnie Pasquantino, Bobby Witt Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Outman, Tyler Tolbert because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
